description: List the people whose kundlis the user has saved on AstroCalc (themselves, parents, partner, children, friends): name, gender, birth place, Moon sign, when it was saved, and an id. Use when the user talks about themselves or a family member by name or relation ('my mother', 'my son') and a saved kundli may exist, or asks who is saved. Read-only. Only for people saved on the user's AstroCalc account (needs a free AstroCalc sign-in); birth details typed in the chat work without sign-in in free_kundli, kundli_milan, explain_dasha, full_chart and life_timeline.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).
